title.narrative: CodeIT, Vietnam, Centre of Exellence for the ASEAN region

description.narrative: Develop a coding hub for the ASEAN region in Vietnam. The developed software will track different mass-produced goods across place of origin, producer, transporter, etc. Relevant goods include agricultural products, farmed fish and other industrial products. The aim is to increase employment opportunities for local programmers and increase quality assurance and transparency of regional goods and trade.
